why: philologist-placeholders-4: the everyday Kabul word for a street shoe-mender is موچی (now lx-10044); کفاش is real but more formal, so the card points to it rather than ruling کفاش out
philologist-placeholders-1: in Afghanistan the person who paints walls is a رنگمال (now lx-10046); نقاش is the artist, so the card says which painter it means and where the other one is

set.glossEn: painter (artist; a house painter is رنگمال)
